Frequently Asked Questions
Questions about graduate studies? We can help.
What are the admission requirements for graduate studies at Dalhousie University?
Admission requirements can be found on the Faculty of Graduate Studies website.
Must applicants identify a prospective supervisor in order to apply to a graduate program in Oceanography?
Applicants to graduate programs must establish personal contact with potential faculty supervisors, and should do so before beginning the formal application process. Our faculty profiles are online; their research falls within four major sub-disciplines. Applicants are encouraged to assess this information in the context of their own backgrounds, interests, and career goals to identify potential advisors to contact.
What funding opportunities are available for graduate studies?
Prospective students are encouraged to visit the Faculty of Graduate Studies website to learn about upcoming funding opportunities.
For further inquiries, please email oceansec@dal.ca.
